about: Reviewed starting inputs for the font-cmap target. The first byte picks the character map format (value modulo 6: 0, 4, 6, 10, 12, 13; bit 3 glyph arrays for format 4; bit 4 code points past U+FFFF for formats 10 and 12; bit 5 a final range drawn by a glyph past the font for formats 4, 12 and 13, which must be refused as a bad cmap); each further byte (up to 32) chooses one range: its distance from the last (low 2 bits), its length (next 3 bits) and its first glyph. Formats 0, 6 and 10 sit beside an empty format 4 map, as OTS requires. The font is built from 2 and 16 copies of the ranges.
